relations.subject: Benjamin Schultze
relations.evidence: he joined the Lutheran Trankebar Mission in 1719, learned quickly Tamil and participated in the conclusion of Ziegenbalg’s Tamil Bible. Ordained priest in Trankebar 1720... left the mission in 1726.
